name: github_token_recognizer
note: GitHub token with a type prefix: ghp_ (personal access), gho_ (OAuth), ghu_ (user-to-server), ghs_ (server-to-server), ghr_ (refresh), + 36 characters. Source: detect-secrets (Apache-2.0) detect_secrets/plugins/github_token.py; leading \b added. Fine-grained tokens (github_pat_…) are not covered by the original plugin.
